in_sanskrit.name: तरुणिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A young, beautiful woman in her prime, full of youthful vigor and charm.

in_hindi.long_meaning: एक तरुणी और उसकी ताकत और विग्रह से संबंधित।

in_marathi.name: Tarunika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tarunika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tarun', meaning 'youthful'. Often used to describe a young, fresh, or immature person.

in_bengali.name: Tarunika
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tarunika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tarun', meaning 'youthful'. Often used to describe a young, fresh, or immature person.
